title: Americans Now Bet $167 Billion A Year On Sports
hook: One Supreme Court case did this.
source: American Gaming Association (AGA) annual commercial gaming reports, first full year after the May 2018 PASPA repeal opened legal sports betting beyond Nevada: handle (total amount wagered) 2019 $13.0B, 2020 $21.5B, 2021 $57.22B, 2022 $93.4B, 2023 $119.84B, 2024 $149.90B, 2025 $166.94B. Sportsbook revenue (the house's cut) over the same years, also AGA: 2019 ~$0.9B, 2020 ~$1.5B, 2021 $4.29B, 2022 $7.5B, 2023 $10.9B (ESPN), 2024 ~$13.7B, 2025 ~$15.8B (approximate from reported handle/hold ratios).
